protocol.purpose: Exploratory comparison of spatially aggregated VIIRS detections with monthly Terra counts
protocol.benchmark_status: Previously inspected archive; exploratory, not an untouched confirmation set

grid.projection: Spherical cylindrical equal-area, standard parallel 36 degrees, longitude origin 0 degrees, latitude origin 0 degrees
grid.aggregation: Mean occupied-cell count over four fixed grid origins, summed over acquisition groups within each UTC month
grid.acquisition_grouping: Sorted source detections share a group while adjacent times are at most 20 minutes apart on the same UTC date; this is an acquisition proxy, not an orbit identifier

protocol.ratio: Coefficient = sum(training Terra counts) / sum(training feature). Output = coefficient times feature.
protocol.lad: Nonnegative slope through the origin minimizing training absolute error: the lower weighted median of Terra/feature with positive feature weights. Zero source remains zero. No intercept or smoothing.
limitations: Grid size, offsets, grouping rule and candidate list were specified before computing this spatial comparison. Earlier count-model experiments had already inspected the same archive years.
Spatial occupancy is a positive-detection density proxy; it does not recreate MODIS footprints, radiances, detection thresholds or missing observations.
Terra and Suomi-NPP observe at different local times. Spatial aggregation does not synchronize their overpasses.
Point-only archives lack cloud-free observation opportunities. Zero qualifying detections does not establish no fire.
Models are selected using 2013-2019 forward validation only. Every candidate is reported on the same 72 later months, including regressions.
Spherical grid lengths are nominal. Four grid origins reduce boundary dependence; they are not independent samples or an uncertainty estimate.
Agreement with Terra counts is not incident detection accuracy, burned area, ignition prediction or firefighting effectiveness.

sources.title: Schroeder et al. (2014), VIIRS 375 m Active Fire Product

limitations: This is a selection-based comparison: selected counties have favorable training-period agreement by construction.
Later years are exploratory and are not independent confirmation of a broadly generalizable harmonization method.
Eligibility requires complete reported monthly counts, not verified observation opportunities or cloud-free coverage.
Agreement with Terra counts is not accuracy against wildfire incidents or burned area.
The current Census boundary is applied consistently to all archive years.
